title: 75-3 穿越式正交墙面及四种方向
current_evidence_scope: 注意：这里先对重建面片做了缝合/裁剪/延伸，再执行普通圆角；原始重建模型保留在中栏。OCC 实际圆角 · R = 1 mm · 通过几何及导出校验。原图特殊模式尚未验证；选边与外形待人工核对。

generic_oracles.quantity: support geometry + finite domains + topology class
generic_oracles.method: Compare independently sampled supports/boundaries, dimensions, placements and material-side occupancy; account for allowed face subdivision. No widening, thickening or pruning source faces.

generic_oracles.expected: exactly requested faces/edges, no silent reselection
generic_oracles.method: Resolve geometric/topological selectors after import; record candidates and expected match count; ambiguous target stops score.
Native checks plus independent seam and occupancy/orientation tests. Save raw BRep even on failure.
Evaluate shared edge and both support surfaces using actual pcurves; sample endpoints/interior and adaptive extrema.
Use consistent material/sheet orientation and evaluate normals at actual seam; end caps only exempt from G1 if declared, never from G0.

target_change: Generate all four orientation solutions from the same two intersecting sheet walls by changing left/right sense only.
must_preserve: Vertical wall extends z[-14,14], floor extends y[-14,14], x[-12,12].
Original normal directions, sheet identity and full finite boundaries stay fixed for all four modes.
Do not trim to a positive quadrant before the operation, thicken to a block, or flip input normals silently.

semantic_target.normal_reference: Actual native face normals must be measured and saved; Parasolid true means behind the wall relative to its normal.

diagnostic_parameters.sign_mapping: Map actual face normals to signed offsets; do not equate SMLib sign to Parasolid boolean without measuring.

feature_oracles.quantity: signed side of blend samples relative to both walls
feature_oracles.method: For actual blend interior points classify dot(p-wall_origin,normal) on each wall; derive expected signs from stored logical sense.

feature_oracles.expected: four distinct quadrant placements with same size
feature_oracles.method: Compare representative longitudinal sections at x=-10,0,10; require nonempty arc contact on both support planes.

feature_oracles.expected: same R for all four orientations
feature_oracles.method: Fit sampled sections independently to circle and test rail-plane incidence/G1.

native_paths.evidence: SMLib/src/SmFilletExecutive.cpp:1306-1505 explicitly creates two signed SmOffsetSurface objects and converts radius signs into solver orientation
native_paths.expresses: Candidate four signed-offset combinations from unchanged supports
native_paths.boundary: Need run all four and check actual geometric sides; no mapping by function name alone.

native_paths.expresses: Convenience native two-surface entry with two signed radius arguments
native_paths.boundary: May introduce finite domain/trim behavior; rejected or empty solution is recorded per sign combination.

gaps.description: Current common-edge bridge only chooses one manifold edge in a prepared quadrant; not a four-sense face-face adapter.
Original diagram has no calibrated R; fixed R4 is a proposed demonstration, not recovered CAD.

inconsistent_if: Only positive-quadrant derivative input is used.
A common-edge R1 is marked four-sense success.
Different inputs/normals/sizes are used to manufacture four shapes.
Return status is success but no actual blend surface exists.
